newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - July 21.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - July 21.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Total investments in tourism projects being implemented by the Saudi private sector exceed 30 billion riyals.
- Italian foreign minister Dini said he was satisfied with the growth of Saudi-Italian economic ties.
- Saudi Arabia launched a campaign against pirated software in the kingdom.
- Saudi date producers hold their first meeting to discuss ways to boost the industry. Saudi Arabia produces around 589,000 tonnes of dates a year.
- Saudi Basic Industries Corp posted 2.3 billion riyals in the first half of 1997.
- Saudi Real Estate Company's net profit decreased to 23.5 million riyals in the first half of 1997 from 33.9 million riyals a year earlier.
